Ella (newhire): hey everyone — first day! quick q: who do i ping for the following? 1) model-serving errors (timeouts/5xx) 2) dedicated capacity / allocation questions 3) private VPC networking access. also where do i file access requests? cc @Linda P :wave:

Sam R: welcome, Ella!! short answers: model-serving -> eng-runtime, capacity/alloc -> eng-platform, VPC & sec -> eng-security (people-ops helps with approvals). for access start with the Access form, see link below. :+1:

Marta I: to add: eng-infra owns cluster ops and node-level issues (k8s, driver/kernel). if nodes are OOMing or GPUs dropping offline, ping infra-oncall. infra handles capacity at the infra layer but not model routing. pinging both eng-platform and eng-infra is ok if unsure.

Jon K: eng-runtime is the right first ping for model-serving problems — latency regressions, KV cache corruption, generation 5xx, prompt-run failures. our oncall alias is @runtime-oncall. if runtime-oncall can’t resolve, they escalate to eng-platform for capacity or eng-security for suspicious errors. example escalation snippet:
```
1) runtime-oncall (eng-runtime) — triage model errors / latency / 5xx
2) eng-platform — capacity, autoscaler, reserved pools, routing fallbacks
3) eng-infra — node/GPU issues, kernel/driver problems
4) eng-security — if data exfil or credentials suspected
```

Linda P: Welcome! For access requests submit the internal Access form (https://redwood.company/access) or create an IT ticket and tag me if you need expedited approvals. For Prod model-serving access you’ll need manager + security approval — usually takes <48h if approvals are staffed. If you get stuck DM me and I’ll follow up. :slightly_smiling_face:

oncall-bot: runtime-oncall rotated to @Alex (oncall) — scheduled until 2026-03-23 15:12 UTC

Sam R: TL;DR (copy for your bookmarks):
• model-serving issues -> message @runtime-oncall or #eng-runtime
• capacity / quotas -> #eng-platform or @eng-platform
• infra (nodes/GPU) -> @infra-oncall or #eng-infra
• access requests -> https://redwood.company/access (cc @Linda P)

Ella (newhire): this is super helpful, thanks folks! one tiny follow up — is there a short contacts doc or matrix i can stash in my notes?

Marta I: yes — i’ll drop a minimal matrix in #new-hires pinned after lunch. also ping @Sam R if you want me to add the infra rota.

Jon K: likewise i’ll put runtime-oncall alias and common runbooks into the new-hires thread doc. if you want, i can paste the basic runbook snippet now:
```
- Check model logs: /var/logs/models/<model>/latest.log
- Check GV cache stats: /api/runtime/cache/stats
- If 5xx, collect request id + sample input and ping runtime-oncall
```

Ella (newhire): perfect — appreciate it :heart:
